inlines.v: UNRU'LINESS, noun [from unruly.] 1. Disregard of restraint; licentiousness; turbulence; as the unruliness of men, or of their passions. 2. The disposition of a beast to break over fences and wander from an inclosure; the practice of breaking or leaping over fences.
